text: Invariant's direction, in @gitdek's words of 2026-09-30: Invariant should let developers mix idiomatic Go and Python with formal verification without forcing entire applications into a restricted dialect. Keep ordinary code natural, prove critical components, and check how the surrounding code interacts with them. Support incremental adoption, clearly distinguishing proved guarantees from tested behavior. Today a component is proved only as a standalone core in the prover's own style, in a project of its own; proving components in place, inside ordinary code, is the next slice, which #210's ratified plan of issues carries out.
